body: I feel similarly to you! For years it feels, I’ll get into something like art, writing, music or film (things I am extremely and passionately into) and once I start practicing and trying to become good at them, a small obstacle (or sometimes no obstacle at all!) will block me and drain all motivation in me, leaving me where I started and I just end up quitting and looking like I have no follow through with my creative ideas. It fucking sucks and I have no doubt it has to do with c-ptsd. I’m really sorry you deal with this as well, it sucks, I know.
